correction_rechecks.rationale: The formal skip predicate now exactly matches the allowed only_on exception and t1/t2/t3.

The route predicates overlap. With current H G1 passed, G2 review active, and a conflicted PR with no candidate CI, route 1 matches because review is active, yet route 2 expressly includes conflict/no CI. Route 1 then says to collect review/CI even though CI cannot start. The new r12 tests cover both-in-flight and pre-G1/no-CI separately, but omit this mixed state. The decision remains under-specified and the original unavailable-gate wait can still be selected.
correction_rechecks.smallest_compatible_fix: Give unavailable/obsolete/unstartable required evidence explicit priority. Ordinary collection requires applicable G1 and each of required G2/G3 to be either terminal or genuinely in flight. Otherwise, an established integration trigger goes through existing pre_review_g1/base_integration without waiting for impossible work. Preserve the existing writer, correction-round and active-budget guards; a route choice or timeout never grants a new budget. Add the mixed state G1 passed + review active + conflict/no CI to r12 and require the integration route, no premature new G2, no missing-CI success and one batch/round.
